Senior military commanders from the U.S., Israel and eight Arab countries secretly met in Germany last week to discuss the war with Iran and the broader regional security situation. Axios reports the meeting, organized by CENTCOM commander Adm. Brad Cooper, included the military chiefs of Israel, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar, Jordan and Egypt. It was the first such gathering since the U.S. and Israel went to war with Iran more than six months ago, and brought together Israeli and Arab military leaders from countries that in some cases still have no diplomatic relations. Cooper reportedly reassured the group that the U.S. will maintain its military presence in the region and briefed them on plans to expand protected shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. The meeting also comes as the Houthis escalate attacks on Saudi Arabia and threaten the Bab al-Mandab. Axios reports Israel, Saudi Arabia and CENTCOM are discussing possible Israeli ISR support for Saudi operations against the Houthis. Source: axios.com/2026/09/15/militar…

Video purporting to show the Panama flagged, Qatar owned oil tanker El Gaia with black smoke rising from its superstructure is circulating online following an apparent attack on the vessel near Oman on September 13. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed the tanker struck a naval mine while making what it described as an unauthorized transit. That account has been disputed by U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM), which says the vessel was previously struck by an Iranian missile and was later attacked by an Iranian drone while off the coast of Oman. The available video does not appear to show obvious hull damage consistent with a mine explosion. India’s Ministry of External Affairs confirmed that 13 of the 14 Indian crew members aboard were rescued, with one Indian national remaining missing. Oman has since reported that 23 crew members were evacuated from the tanker, while search operations continue for two missing crew members. The vessel is being towed toward Oman. Video

The new granite helipad on the White House South Lawn is now complete, paving the way for the U.S. Marine Corps’ VH-92A "Patriot" to routinely operate as "Marine One" from the White House grounds. The VH-92A had seen limited use for White House arrivals and departures because its downward directed exhaust can generate enough heat to scorch or damage the South Lawn. The Marine Corps had therefore continued using the older VH-3D helicopter for South Lawn operations. President Donald J. Trump approved construction of the permanent landing pad, with Sikorsky, the VH-92A manufacturer and a Lockheed Martin subsidiary, providing approximately $5 million to fund the project. The VH-92A is intended to replace the legacy presidential helicopter fleet and provide the president with secure presidential airlift for both routine and contingency operations. This image was posted to President Trump's Truth Social page yesterday.

O Brasil está dando mais um passo para fortalecer sua economia digital. Sancionei hoje o Redata, um regime especial que cria incentivos para a instalação e ampliação de datacenters no país e pode contribuir para atrair investimentos e ampliar nossa capacidade em áreas como inteligência artificial, computação em nuvem e outras tecnologias digitais. Atualmente, a maioria dos dados e serviços digitais usados no Brasil é processada fora do país. Com o Redata, queremos ampliar essa capacidade aqui dentro, sob as nossas leis e com mais soberania sobre os nossos dados. E quem receber incentivo público vai ter que dar retorno ao país: investir no Brasil o equivalente a 2% do valor dos equipamentos beneficiados em pesquisa, desenvolvimento e inovação, reservar pelo menos 10% da capacidade de processamento, armazenagem e tratamento de dados para o mercado nacional e cumprir regras de alta eficiência no uso da água e de energia limpa e de baixa emissão. O programa também cria condições mais favoráveis para investimentos no Norte, Nordeste e Centro-Oeste, contribuindo para ampliar a presença da infraestrutura digital em diferentes regiões do Brasil. O Redata faz parte do esforço para fortalecer nossa capacidade tecnológica, estimular inovação e gerar novas oportunidades de desenvolvimento no país. 📸 @ricardostuckert

وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف کی زیر صدارت ملکی برآمدات بڑھانے اور معاشی ترقی کی رفتار تیز کرنے کے حوالے سے جائزہ اجلاس آج اسلام آباد میں منعقد ہوا. اجلاس سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ برآمدات میں اضافے کو ملکی معاشی ترقی کی بنیاد بنایا جائے اور روایتی شعبوں کے ساتھ ساتھ مزید شعبوں کو بھی عالمی منڈیوں میں برآمدات کے لیے تیار کیا جائے. تجارت کو متنوع بنانے کے لیے زیادہ سے زیادہ شعبوں اور صنعتوں کو برآمدی سرگرمیوں میں شامل کیا جائے. پاکستانی مصنوعات کے معیار کو عالمی معیار کے مطابق بنانے، کوالٹی اشورنس کے نظام کو مؤثر بنانے اور بین الاقوامی معیار و ضوابط پر مکمل عملدرآمد یقینی بنانے کے لیے مؤثر اقدامات لیے جائیں. گفتگو کے دوران وزیرِ اعظم نے مزید کہا کہ برآمدات میں ویلیو ایڈیشن پر خصوصی توجہ دی جائے تاکہ پاکستانی مصنوعات کی عالمی منڈی میں قدر اور مسابقت دونوں میں اضافہ ہو. وزیراعظم نے برآمدی صنعتوں کے لیے جدید ٹیکنالوجی، تحقیق اور جدت کو فروغ دینے کی ہدایت کی. انہوں نے کہا کہ ملکی معیشت کو جدید تقاضوں سے ہم آہنگ کرنے کے لیے ڈیجیٹلائزیشن اور جدید ٹیکنالوجی سے بھرپور استفادہ کیا جائے. برآمد کنندگان کو درپیش انتظامی اور کاروباری رکاوٹیں دور کی جائیں اور برآمدی عمل کو مزید آسان، تیز اور شفاف بنایا جائے. اجلاس میں برآمدات کے فروغ کیلئے منظور شدہ اسٹرٹیجک روڈ میپ پر عملدرآمد سے متعلق پیشرفت پر بریفنگ دی گئی اور نئی عالمی منڈیوں تک رسائی، برآمدی شعبوں میں تنوع، مصنوعات کے معیار میں بہتری اور کاروباری سہولت کاری کے حوالے سے مختلف تجاویز کا جائزہ لیا گیا۔ اجلاس میں برآمدی شعبوں کی عالمی سطح پر مسابقتی صلاحیت بہتر بنانے پر بھی تفصیلی غور کیا گیا. بریفنگ میں بتایا گیا کہ عالمی مارکیٹ تک پاکستانی مصنوعات کی رسائی بڑھانے کے لئے متعدد دوست ممالک سے فری ٹریڈ ایگریمنٹ اور رعایتی نرخوں پر تجارت کے معاہدوں کے لیے اقدامات لیے جا رہے ہیں. پاکستانی ہارٹیکلچرل مصنوعات کو برآمدات میں شامل کرنے کے لیے اقدامات لیے جا رہے ہیں. پاکستانی سرجیکل اور میڈیکل آلات کی برآمدات بڑھانے کیلئے بین الاقوامی ہسپتالوں کے ٹینڈرز اور پروکیورمنٹ میں پاکستانی ایکسپورٹرز کی شمولیت کی حوصلہ افزائی کی جا رہی ہے. بریفنگ میں مزید بتایا گیا کہ عالمی کمپنیوں کو پاکستانی مصنوعات سے روشناس کرانے کے لیے ٹیکسپو (TEXPO)، ہیلتھ انجینئرنگ اینڈ منرلز شو، فوڈ اینڈ ایگریکلچر (FoodAg) اور دیگر شعبوں سے متعلق نمائشیں ملک کے مختلف شہروں میں منعقد کی جا رہی ہیں. برآمدات میں جدت کو فروغ دینے کے لیے انٹیلیکچؤل پراپرٹی قوانین کو دور حاضر کے تقاضوں ہم آہنگ کرنے پر کام جاری ہے. ایکسپورٹ ڈویلپمنٹ فنڈ کی تنظیم نو کا عمل مکمل ہو چکا ہے اور ای ڈی ایف کی جانب سے کاروباری برادری کے لیے سہولت کے حوالے سے اقدامات لیے جا رہے ہیں. اجلاس میں نائب وزیراعظم و وزیر خارجہ محمد اسحاق ڈار، وفاقی وزراء رانا تنویر حسین، جام کمال خان، ڈاکٹر مصدق مسعود ملک، احد خان چیمہ، محمد اورنگزیب، مشیر وزیراعظم ہارون اختر، وزیر مملکت برائے خزانہ بلال اظہر کیانی اور متعلقہ اداروں کے اعلیٰ افسران شریک تھے۔ Video

وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف سے چیئرمین نیشنل ڈیزاسٹر مینجمنٹ اتھارٹی (NDMA) لیفٹیننٹ جنرل انعام حیدر ملک کی ملاقات ہوئی. لیفٹیننٹ جنرل انعام حیدر ملک نے وزیراعظم کو حالیہ مون سون سیزن میں شدید بارشوں اور ممکنہ سیلابی صورتحال سے نبرد آزما ہونے کے لئے پیشگی انتظامات پر بریف کیا. وزیرِ اعظم نے ہدایت کی کہ بارشوں سے متاثرہ علاقوں میں عوام کو ہر ممکن امداد اور ریلیف فراہم کرنے کے لیے تمام دستیاب وسائل بروئے کار لائے جائیں. بارشوں کے دوران رابطہ سڑکوں اور پلوں پر ٹریفک کی روانی یقینی بنانے اور امدادی سامان کی ترسیل کے حوالے سے متعلقہ محکموں کے ساتھ روابط بڑھائے جائیں. وزیر اعظم نے این ڈی ایم اے کو متعلقہ صوبائی اداروں اور پی ڈی ایم ایز کے ساتھ موثر رابطہ رکھنے کی ہدایت بھی جاری کی. چیئرمین این ڈی ایم اے نے کہا کہ وزیراعظم کے ہدایت کردہ پیشگی انتظامات کے باعث متعلقہ ادارے اس مون سون سیزن کی موثر اقدامات کے ساتھ بہتر انداز میں نگرانی کر سکے. انہوں نے وزیراعظم کو جاری مون سون سیزن کے متوقع رجحان اور صوبوں اور ادراوں کے باہمی تعاون سے جاری مجموعی انتظامات کی صورتحال سے آگاہ کرتے ہوئے بتایا کہ ملک کے طول و عرض میں کسی بھی ہنگامی موسمی صورتحال کے پیش نظر تمام متعلقہ ادارے ریسکیو اور ریلیف کے لئے تیار ہیں.

Dr. Joram Aniya, Member, NITI Aayog, along with officers from NITI Aayog, visited Meghalaya to engage with the State Government and understand key development priorities, sectoral initiatives and promising practices that can be strengthened and scaled. The State showcased innovative interventions across sports and sports science, ecological conservation, education, healthcare and organic agriculture. At the SAI Centre at NEHU, Sports Science Center and Army Boys Sports Company in Shillong, Dr. Aniya interacted with athletes and coaches across disciplines including archery, football, wushu and boxing. At Siej village, Dr. Aniya visited a living Root Bridge and interacted with Shri Hally War, farmer and environmentalist and Padma Shri awardee, to learn about efforts to preserve Meghalaya’s traditional living root bridges. In Ri Bhoi, an Aspirational District, she visited the Northeast’s first organic processing facility for dried ginger and turmeric. The visit also included interactions with frontline health workers at PHCs and Sub-Centres, along with visits to the Chief Minister’s Youth Centre and Eklavya Model Residential School, providing insights into grassroots initiatives in health, skilling and education. The engagement highlighted opportunities to build on Meghalaya’s strengths through innovation, sustainability and inclusive growth, while addressing existing challenges and supporting the State’s development priorities towards Viksit Bharat@2047. #Meghalaya #NITI4Development #ViksitBharat2047 @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp

Dr. Joram Aniya, Member, NITI Aayog, engaged with the leadership and senior officers of the Government of Meghalaya to discuss the State’s development priorities, sectoral initiatives and best practices. Dr. Aniya held discussions with Shri C. H. Vijayashankar, Governor of Meghalaya, and Dr. Shakil P. Ahammed, Chief Secretary of Meghalaya, along with senior officers from various departments. The discussions covered key areas including health, education, sports and youth affairs, arts and culture, and tourism. The interaction with the Shri Vijayashankar focused on Meghalaya’s priorities in health and education, as well as strengthening indigenous knowledge and practices through AYUSH. Discussions with Dr. Ahammed and departmental officers covered school education, sports science and infrastructure, cultural heritage conservation and tourism development. The visit provided valuable insights into the State’s development landscape and opportunities for further collaboration, with a focus on strengthening and scaling innovative initiatives for inclusive, sustainable and people-centric development towards Viksit Bharat@2047. #Meghalaya #NITI4Development #ViksitBharat2047 @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp

माननीय रक्षा मंत्री ने 'डिफेंस सिस्टम्स फॉर रेजिलिएंट भारत – रक्षा में आत्मनिर्भरता की ओर’ नाम की एक किताब का विमोचन भी किया गया। इस किताब में 2014 से 2026 के दौरान DRDO द्वारा विकसित महत्वपूर्ण रक्षा प्रणालियों का विवरण दिया गया है, साथ ही DRDO में ‘मानव संसाधन आउटसोर्सिंग सेवा अनुबंधों के लिए दिशानिर्देश’ भी शामिल हैं। इसके अतिरिक्त इंडस्ट्री की पहुँच बढ़ाने और ज़मीनी स्तर पर भागीदारी को बढ़ावा देने के लिए 'सोसाइटी ऑफ़ इंडियन डिफेंस मैन्युफ़ैक्चरर्स' (SIDM) और 'लघु उद्योग भारती' (LUB) के साथ भी औपचारिक रूप से रणनीतिक MoU (समझौता ज्ञापन) किए गए। DRDO ने घरेलू रक्षा कंपनियों की मैन्युफ़ैक्चरिंग मैच्योरिटी (निर्माण परिपक्वता) को मापने के लिए 'क्वालिटी काउंसिल ऑफ़ इंडिया' के साथ 'सिस्टम फ़ॉर एडवांस्ड मैन्युफ़ैक्चरिंग असेसमेंट एंड रेटिंग' (SAMAR) वर्जन 2.0 के लिए एक कॉन्ट्रैक्ट पर भी हस्ताक्षर किए।

कार्यक्रम के दौरान माननीय रक्षा मंत्री ने डीआरडीओ द्वारा स्टार्टअप्स के सशक्तिकरण हेतु नीति का अनावरण किया तथा लाइसेंसधारी उद्योगों के साथ सॉफ्टवेयर सोर्स कोड साझा करने हेतु रूपरेखा का शुभारंभ किया। माननीय रक्षा मंत्री की उपस्थिति में 13 उद्योगों को प्रौद्योगिकी हस्तांतरण हेतु नौ लाइसेंसिंग समझौते (LAToTs) भी प्रदान किए गए।

Of the rice India shipped to the EU, 52 consignments were flagged in 2025, and about one rejection for every 9,100 tonnes. The ICRIER study traces the problem to an accountability gap, with oversight split between APEDA and the Export Inspection Council and no clear division of responsibility. Most rejections stem from pesticide residues banned in the EU but still used in India. Its recommendation: consolidate export oversight under a single nodal agency with end-to-end traceability. The working paper gives a systematic estimate of employment in India's cultural and creative economy. It also finds that the sector now employs about 57 million people, having added over 16 million jobs (a 40% rise) between 2017-18 and 2025. Now among India's top employers, accounting for nearly 9% of the total workforce and 16.7% of urban jobs, the sector saw women's employment more than double to 18.8 million. হাটহাজারীতে ফিল্ড ফায়ারিং অনুশীলনে শহিদ সেনাসদস্যদের পরিবারের সঙ্গে প্রধানমন্ত্রীর সাক্ষাৎ ঢাকা, ১৫ সেপ্টেম্বর ২০২৬ (মঙ্গলবার): চট্টগ্রামের হাটহাজারী ফিল্ড ফায়ারিং রেঞ্জে ট্যাংক ফায়ারিং অনুশীলনকালে সংঘটিত দুর্ঘটনায় শহিদ দুই সেনাসদস্যের শোকসন্তপ্ত পরিবারের সদস্যদের সঙ্গে আজ সাক্ষাৎ করেন প্রধানমন্ত্রী জনাব তারেক রহমান, এমপি এবং তাঁর সহধর্মিনী ডা: জুবাইদা রহমান। এ সময় তিনি শহিদদের পরিবারের সদস্যদের প্রতি গভীর সমবেদনা প্রকাশ করেন, তাঁদের সার্বিক খোঁজখবর নেন এবং আর্থিক সহায়তার চেক হস্তান্তর করেন। সাক্ষাৎকালে প্রধানমন্ত্রী বলেন, "দেশের জন্য দায়িত্ব পালন করতে গিয়ে আমাদের সেনাসদস্যরা প্রাণ দিয়েছেন। তাঁরা দেশের জন্য শহিদ হয়েছেন। তাঁদের এই আত্মত্যাগ জাতি গভীর শ্রদ্ধার সঙ্গে স্মরণ করবে।" শোকসন্তপ্ত পরিবারের সদস্যদের উদ্দেশ্যে প্রধানমন্ত্রী বলেন, "এই শোকের সময়ে আমরা আপনাদের পাশে আছি এবং পাশে থাকব। সরকার ও সেনাবাহিনী সব সময় আপনাদের পরিবারের পাশে থাকবে। প্রয়োজনীয় সহযোগিতা দেওয়ার পাশাপাশি শহিদ সেনাসদস্যদের পরিবারের দেখভালেও সরকার তার দায়িত্ব পালন করবে।" এ সময় সেনাবাহিনী প্রধান জেনারেল ওয়াকার-উজ-জামান, এসবিপি, ওএসপি, এসজিপি, পিএসসি এবং ঊর্ধ্বতন পর্যায়ের সামরিক ও অসামরিক কর্মকর্তাগণ উপস্থিত ছিলেন।

STATEMENT BY PRESIDENT RAMAPHOSA ON KILLINGS OF WOMEN IN THE EAST RAND President @CyrilRamaphosa has said that no stone will be left unturned to solve the recent killings of women in and around Kempton Park in Gauteng. He said: “I speak for all of us as I extend my deepest condolences to all families and communities affected by the killing of women recently found in and around Kempton Park. “These incidents are causing fear and uncertainty in our communities, and especially among women. “As government, we share the concerns of all South Africans, and we mourn the lives so cruelly taken away. “Our law enforcement agencies are working urgently to establish the facts, keep communities safe, and bring the perpetrator or perpetrators to justice. “I have spoken to the Minister of Police and the Acting National Police Commissioner, who have briefed me on the investigation. I have directed that these cases be prioritised and that no stone be left unturned in bringing those responsible to justice. “Our law enforcement agencies are undertaking this work in partnership with citizens, on whom we depend for any information that may help end these attacks on women. “As a nation, we must stand up for the rights, safety and dignity of women and girls. “As we do so, our hearts go out to all the families affected by the terrible events in the Kempton Park area. “If anyone has information about these incidents or if you are missing a relative or friend, please contact Warrant Officer Elvis Manyike on 082 465 7249.” ISSUED BY THE PRESIDENCY OF THE REPUBLIC OF SOUTH AFRICA

Four years after I launched @IAEAorg’s #RaysOfHope, we are translating the promise of nuclear science into cancer care for people who previously had little or no access to it. More than 100 countries are receiving support, over 150 pieces of major cancer diagnosis and treatment equipment have been procured, and more than 170 specialized medical professionals have started long-term training. But the real measure of progress is not just equipment delivered. It is people receiving care where that care did not exist before. And indeed the need remains enormous: in 2024, 20.6 million people were diagnosed with cancer and nearly 10 million died from the disease. That’s exactly why our ambition goes beyond delivering machines: we want to help countries build the people, institutions and capabilities needed to provide safe, high-quality cancer care for the long term. Our 21 #RaysOfHope Anchor Centres, with Singapore joining just yesterday, are central to this effort. Now we must build on this momentum and scale up our work: governments, cancer centres, development and financing institutions and the private sector all have a role to play so we can extend the reach and impact of #RaysOfHope to many more patients. Where someone is born or where they live should not determine whether they can receive the cancer diagnosis and treatment that could save their life. Grateful to Tanzania VP Deogratius John Ndejembi and @TheOPECFund President Abdulhamid Alkhalifa for joining me to open the #IAEAGC Scientific Forum, as well as to all the ministers attending, in a clear sign of the growing commitment to turning this ambition into reality. Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, on 15 September 2026, delivered remarks at the Reception commemorating the fifth anniversary of the ASEAN–China Comprehensive Strategic Partnership (CSP) in Beijing, China, on the sidelines of his working visit to China. In his remarks, Dr. Kao highlighted the steady progress of ASEAN–China relations over the past 35 years and the achievements of cooperation under the CSP. He underscored the importance of building on this milestone to further deepen cooperation, including through the implementation of the ASEAN–China Plan of Action 2026–2030. He also emphasised the shared goal of advancing a more connected, resilient, innovative, sustainable and people-centred ASEAN-China partnership that delivers benefits for both sides and the wider region. The facility is involved in supplying the russian armed forces with unmanned systems. ⚡️ Following an analysis of additional data, the destruction of three storage tanks and damage to eight others at the Slavyansk ECO oil refinery in Slavyansk-on-Kuban, Krasnodar Krai, russian federation, on 13th September 2026 have been confirmed. Maharashtra Takes a Giant Step in Shipbuilding! 🚢 🤝 CM Devendra Fadnavis presided over the signing and exchange of an MoU between National Shipbuilding and Heavy Industries Park Maharashtra Limited (NSHIPML) and Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited (MDL) at Mantralaya in Mumbai today for the establishment of the Greenfield Shipbuilding Cluster. This MoU will boost the construction of large commercial vessels in the state while further strengthening shipbuilding capacity and the maritime industry. Details of the MoU: 🔸 Project: Greenfield Shipbuilding Industrial Cluster 🔸 Location: Dighi, Raigad, Maharashtra 🔸 Anchor Shipyard: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited (MDL) 🔸 Shipbuilding Capacity: At least 1.2 million Gross Tonnage (GT) per annum 🔸 In-principle approved for an expenditure of ₹27,500 crore for the project by the National Shipbuilding Mission. Minister Nitesh Rane, Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited (MDL) Chairman and Managing Director Capt. Jagmohan, IN (Retd.) and senior officials were present. 🤝 मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या प्रमुख उपस्थितीत मंत्रालय, मुंबई येथे आज नॅशनल शिपबिल्डिंग अँड हेवी इंडस्ट्रीज पार्क महाराष्ट्र लिमिटेड (NSHIPML) आणि माझगाव डॉक शिपबिल्डर्स लिमिटेड (MDL) यांच्यात ग्रीनफिल्ड शिपबिल्डिंग क्लस्टर उभारण्यासाठी सामंजस्य करार करण्यात आला. या करारामुळे राज्यात मोठ्या व्यावसायिक जहाजांच्या निर्मितीला चालना मिळणार असून जहाजबांधणी क्षमता व सागरी उद्योग अधिक बळकट होणार आहे. सामंजस्य कराराचा तपशील : 🔸 प्रकल्प : ग्रीनफिल्ड शिपबिल्डिंग इंडस्ट्रियल क्लस्टर 🔸 स्थान : दिघी, रायगड, महाराष्ट्र 🔸 अँकर शिपयार्ड : माझगाव डॉक शिपबिल्डर्स लिमिटेड (MDL) 🔸 जहाजबांधणी क्षमता : दरवर्षी किमान 1.2 दशलक्ष ग्रॉस टनेज (GT) 🔸नॅशनल शिपविल्डींग मिशन यांच्याकडून या प्रकल्पास ₹27,500 कोटींच्या खर्चास तत्वतः मंजुरी यावेळी मंत्री नितेश राणे, माझगाव डॉक शिपबिल्डर्स लिमिटेड (MDL) चे अध्यक्ष व व्यवस्थापकीय संचालक कॅप्टन जगमोहन, IN (निवृत्त) व वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @NiteshNRane #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #Mumbai

40 yrs ago, Iranians were victims of chemical weapons while the world watched. On Feb 28, Lamerd became a testing ground for new barbaric weapons. We must ensure that those who committed this war crime—& those who knowingly enabled them—are brought to justice #JusticeForLamerd Reza Nasri (@RezaNasri1) Today, I stood in Lamerd. I had read the reports. I had studied the forensic reconstructions by Airwars, The New York Times, BBC Verify, the painstaking work on trajectory angles, fragmentation patterns and blast radii. None of it prepared me for standing beneath these walls, or meeting the people who live behind them. Lamerd is a small city of about 30,000 people in Fars province. It is the kind of place where a stranger is offered food before anyone asks his name. I have rarely encountered a community so instinctively and openly hospitable. People who had only recently buried their children still insisted on pouring us tea. That warmth, in the face of what was done to them, is the first thing the world should know about Lamerd. The second is what these walls tell you, if you take the time to look. On February 28, 2026, the opening day of the US-Israeli war on Iran, the United States fired Precision Strike Missiles into this city. Independent forensic reconstruction has identified at least three. Eye witnesses say there were four. The PrSM is not an ordinary missile. It does not simply strike a point on the ground. It detonates in the air, roughly fifteen to twenty metres above the surface, turning the area beneath it into a killing zone. The blast sends tens of thousands of white-hot tungsten fragments in every direction, ripping through walls, cars and human bodies. Investigators counted more than 2,000 individual fragment impacts along a single 150-metre stretch of one residential street. I walked that street today. I did not need the number. I could see it. Look at the photographs. The facades are not simply damaged. They are pocked from roofline to foundation, in a pattern no accident could produce. The asphalt of the schoolyard is covered with hundreds of small grey scars where fragments struck the pavement. Then there is the steel door. The kind of door you would find on any modest home. It has been punched through in a dozen places. Taped above the holes is a photograph of a curly-haired toddler. Her name was Avina Barzegar. She was two years old. She was killed in her family's backyard. This is how the attack was described to us by people who lived through it. A missile struck first, directly above the Shahid Naimi sports hall, where a girls' volleyball team was training. Panic followed. People did what people instinctively do when something explodes nearby: they ran outside, toward the open air, believing that was where they might be safe. That was when the second missile came down. Then a third. Then a fourth. Each detonated over a different part of the same small city: a school, a residential area, places where people had run because they thought the street was safer than the building they had been inside. At least 21 civilians were killed that day, including children as young as two. More than 170 were wounded. Spinal injuries. Amputations. Catastrophic burns. We met the family of a seventeen-year-old girl who lost both eyes. We met the family of another young girl who will spend the rest of her life in a wheelchair, her spine severed by fragments that fell from a clear afternoon sky. I heard about a little girl who no longer speaks. The trauma and bleeding in her brain took her voice, along with so much of what childhood was supposed to give her. None of these girls carried a rifle. None wore a uniform. Among those killed and maimed in Lamerd, there was not a single member of an armed force, Iranian or otherwise. According to the forensic reconstruction, the missiles were launched from mobile batteries in a Persian Gulf Arab state that hosts American forces, a state that would later condemn Iran when Iran exercised its inherent right of self-defense. And what was Washington's response? It was not that Lamerd contained a military target. No such target has ever been identified by CENTCOM. Instead, the story changed. First, a CENTCOM spokesman flatly said that no American strike had taken place within thirty miles of Lamerd that day. Then footage emerged that could no longer be dismissed. The explanation changed. The missile seen in the footage, they said, was actually an Iranian Hoveyzeh cruise missile. Weapons analysts at Janes and McKenzie Intelligence, along with the visual-forensics teams at The New York Times and BBC Verify, examined the same footage independently. They reached the same conclusion. The silhouette, the mid-air detonation and the fragmentation pattern all pointed to one weapon used in that theater. It was not Iranian. None of this should surprise anyone who has followed this war closely. The PrSM had never been used in combat before February 28. Lamerd was its combat debut. A live-fire demonstration in a civilian city, whose geography apparently made it a convenient proving ground. And by the Pentagon's own measure, the test was a success. Within a month, Lockheed Martin had reached a new agreement with the Department of War to quadruple PrSM production, later reported by independent investigators to be worth some $8.4 billion. Days after the missile killed Avina Barzegar, CENTCOM commander Adm. Brad Cooper publicly celebrated its combat debut, calling it "an unrivaled deep strike capability." Tell that to the toddler on the door. Iranian civil society will not allow what happened in Lamerd to disappear the way so much of Iraq and Afghanistan disappeared from public memory. Those societies had their bar associations, universities and forensic institutions hollowed out by decades of dictatorship, invasion and war before anyone expected them to build a serious case file. Iran does not face those same constraints. It has tens of thousands of practicing lawyers, a functioning forensic medicine system, land and hospital registries, dozens of law faculties, and a diaspora that includes lawyers admitted to practice in jurisdictions that recognize universal jurisdiction. We will use every one of them. We will pursue Donald Trump, Marco Rubio, Pete Hegseth, Adm. Brad Cooper, and every officer who executed their orders, in every forum on this earth that will hear us, for as long as it takes. This is not only Iran's fight. People anywhere, including in the United States and Europe, can do something about it. 1- Pursue universal jurisdiction. If you live in a country that recognizes universal jurisdiction over grave breaches of the Geneva Conventions, press prosecutors to open a file. Many of these governments speak constantly about the independence of their judiciaries. This is where that claim gets tested. The legal basis exists. The precedents exist. 2- Demand an end to the contracts: Demand that your government, and any government with a Lockheed Martin contract, cancel it. Every state party to the Geneva Conventions has obligations to "ensure respect" for international humanitarian law. Those obligations do not disappear because a weapons contract is profitable. A company should not be able to field-test a weapon on a residential street and then collect billions of dollars to manufacture more of it. 3- Say their names. Be loud. Organize. Say Avina Barzegar's name. Say the names of the other children killed on that street. Keep saying them until they cannot be forgotten. Let Lamerd become the case that finally forces the world to confront this weapon and ban its use against civilians, so that no city anywhere becomes someone else's proving ground again. And do not accept, for one second, the claim that this is "still under investigation." This is a government that has told the American public that it can read an Iranian officer's name tag from a satellite in orbit. It closed the Lamerd file within days, through denial, without answering the questions raised by BBC Verify, The New York Times or Airwars. An administration with that level of claimed surveillance capability does not need more time to determine who fired four missiles into a city of 30,000 people. It has known since the morning of February 28. It has decided that the truth is inconvenient. Avina Barzegar was two years old. That is why we do not stop. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/RezaNasri1/status/2098781595360518197#m

War crimes and crimes against humanity are not erased by political narratives, military necessity or passage of time. International law is clear: Those who order, commit, facilitate, or knowingly enable such crimes bear individual criminal responsibility. #JusticeforLamerd Reza Nasri (@RezaNasri1) An Open Letter to @LockheedMartin To James D. Taiclet, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, and to the Board of Directors. I have just returned from Lamerd, a city of thirty thousand in Iran's Fars province. On 28 February 2026, the opening day of the American and Israeli war on Iran, United States forces fired Precision Strike Missiles built by your corporation into its residential streets, its school and its sports hall. Twenty-one civilians were killed. More than one hundred and seventy were wounded — among them children who will live the rest of their lives without sight, without limbs, or without the use of their spines. The youngest of the dead was Avina Barzegar. She was two. Her photograph is taped above the fragment holes in her family's steel door. I have stood in front of it. Within a month, your corporation signed an agreement to quadruple production of the weapon that did this, reported at some $8.4 billion. I write because the legal consequences of having done so knowingly are more serious than your officers appear to have been advised. What occurred at Lamerd was a war crime. There was no military objective. Under the customary rule reflected in Article 52(2) of Additional Protocol, an object may be attacked only where it effectively contributes to military action and its destruction offers a definite military advantage. In six months, Central Command has identified no such object in Lamerd. It first claimed no American strike occurred within thirty miles of the city. When video made that untenable, it claimed the munition was an Iranian cruise missile, a claim rejected independently by Janes, McKenzie Intelligence, The New York Times and BBC Verify, each identifying the silhouette, the airburst and the fragmentation pattern of one weapon in that theatre. Yours. A denial is not a justification. Where an attacker answers civilian deaths by denying the attack rather than defending the target, it forecloses every defence the law makes available to it. The means were indiscriminate. The PrSM detonates fifteen to twenty metres above ground and disperses tens of thousands of tungsten fragments across a wide area. Investigators counted thousands of fragment impacts along a single 150-metre stretch of one residential street. The casualty pattern is not evidence of a strike gone wrong. It is evidence of the weapon working exactly as designed, in a place where its design guaranteed the result. And the strikes were successive. The first detonated above a sports hall where a girls' volleyball team was training. People ran into the open. The second fell on them. Then a third, then a fourth. Whatever might be argued about the first, nothing explains the rest except a decision taken with knowledge of what the first had just done. A city is not a proving ground. The PrSM had never been used in combat before that day. Lamerd was its debut, and Central Command's commander publicly praised that debut within days. It is sometimes assumed that validating a weapon under operational conditions is a military benefit that can be weighed in the balance. It cannot. The advantage the law requires must be "definite", "concrete and direct" — language chosen precisely to exclude benefits that are speculative, generalised or deferred. Performance data accrues to a production line, not to an attack. It belongs to no part of the balance a commander is permitted to strike. If the rationale was to observe the weapon's effects under live conditions, the civilians of Lamerd were not incidental to the object of the attack. They were the medium on which effectiveness was measured. The contract was made with knowledge. Complicity does not require sharing the perpetrator's purpose. It requires assistance having a substantial effect, furnished with knowledge. That is the standard on which the Hamburg court convicted the suppliers of Zyklon B in 1946; on which the Netherlands convicted Frans van Anraat for supplying chemical precursors to Iraq, holding expressly that the lawful commercial form of the transaction gave him no shelter; and which the French Cour de cassation confirmed reaches corporations in Lafarge. Your original contracts predate Lamerd. The expansion does not. By the time it was signed, the forensic record was public, the official account had collapsed twice, and CENTCOM had itself identified the operation as the weapon's combat debut. A prime contractor does not learn of its munition's first combat use from the newspapers. The expansion was not made in ignorance of how the weapon performed at Lamerd. It was made because of it. Your counsel will know that the corporation is not the principal exposure. Nuremberg did not try I.G. Farben or Krupp; it tried the men who ran them. Van Anraat went to prison as an individual. Officers who authorise continued manufacture and transfer after notice do so in their own names, in a world where Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, France, Spain, Sweden and others exercise universal jurisdiction over grave breaches. That exposure does not lapse, and it travels. Accordingly: rescind the expansion agreement; suspend production and transfer pending an independent forensic investigation; preserve and disclose the performance data you hold on the Lamerd employment, because it is evidence; and cooperate with any prosecuting authority that opens a file. The answer that these are matters for the government and not the contractor was made at Nuremberg and failed there. A company that builds the weapon, receives the data on what it did to a city of thirty thousand, and then contracts to build four times as many is not a bystander to the decision. Do not repeat the claim that the matter is still under investigation. This is a government that tells its public it can read a name tag from orbit. It closed the Lamerd file in days, by denial, without answering a single question put to it. It has known since the morning of 28 February. It has decided the truth is inconvenient. Your corporation is now being asked whether it has decided the same. Avina Barzegar was two years old. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/RezaNasri1/status/2099166408122798584#m

New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani and Attorney General Letitia James are suing the Trump administration to block a new immigration rule that would expand when the government can deny green card and visa applications based on an applicant's potential use of public benefits. The expanded "public charge" rule is set to take effect Sept. 18 and would broaden the benefits immigration officials can consider. Mamdani argues the policy creates "uncertainty and fear" among immigrant New Yorkers, while James is leading a separate challenge with 21 states and Washington, D.C. Several major cities and counties across the country are joining New York's lawsuit, including Chicago, San Francisco, Seattle, Santa Clara County and King County, Mamdani said.

🔁STATEMENT | The Acting National Commissioner of the South African Police Service (SAPS), Lieutenant General Puleng Dimpane, has vowed that the #SAPS will leave no stone unturned in ensuring that those responsible for the murders of women in Gauteng are identified, traced, and brought to justice. @SAPoliceService #EndGBVF #GovZAUpdates SA Police Service 🇿🇦 (@SAPoliceService) #sapsHQ [ACTING NATIONAL COMMISSIONER VOWS TO FIND THOSE RESPONSIBLE FOR WOMEN’S DEATHS IN GAUTENG AND SENDS CONDOLENCES TO THE MOSELAKGOMO FAMILY] The Acting National Commissioner of the South African Police Service (SAPS), Lieutenant General Puleng Dimpane, has vowed that the #SAPS will leave no stone unturned in ensuring that those responsible for the murders of women in Gauteng are identified, traced, and brought to justice. This follows the discovery of a fifth body in Gauteng today, as investigations into a number of cases involving the deaths of women in the Kempton Park area continue. Lieutenant General Dimpane has also expressed her deepest condolences to the family and loved ones of 38-year-old Elizabeth “Tsontso” Moselakgomo, whose body was positively identified today at the Germiston mortuary by her family. “We extend our deepest sympathies to the family and loved ones of Elizabeth during this extremely painful time. The Acting National Commissioner has directed the multidisciplinary team comprising detectives and other specialised policing resources to intensify the investigation into these cases. The team is working around the clock to establish the circumstances surrounding each death, analyse available evidence, identify possible linkages where they exist, and pursue all leads that may assist in bringing the investigations to a successful conclusion. Lieutenant General Dimpane has further assured the public that the SAPS remains fully committed to protecting women and bringing perpetrators of violence against women to justice. “We will not rest until we have established the truth. Where there is evidence linking individuals to these crimes, we will pursue them relentlessly and ensure that they face the full might of the law,” said Lieutenant General Dimpane. Thus far one suspect has been arrested in connection with the discovery of the first body in July. Any pursuit of superintelligence has to be grounded in the core principle that if the AI we build is not helping humanity and under human control, it's not worth pursuing. We also need to accelerate and spread the benefits of AI, such that they are diffused broadly across countries, communities, and companies. This requires a frontier ecosystem in which both closed and open-source models can thrive. And for firms, it’s imperative that they retain full control over their unique and tacit knowledge. Every organization should be able to build its own continuous learning loop/hill climbing machine, without becoming dependent on any one model provider, and have the ability to embed its own knowledge into models and weights they control. So, in this context, we welcome the research, focus, and deliberate pacing needed to get alignment right as the design goal. We also welcome ideas like "embedded evaluators" and the broader efforts to develop the mechanisms to make this more than just talk. The key is that this cannot be controlled by a handful of entities, but must have broad representation across the ecosystem, countries, and fields, including academia. This is the approach we are taking: broad access and choice at every layer of the AI stack; enterprise control of learning loops and models; and the “Code of Conduct” that underlies our own first party MAI models that we’ll publish tomorrow for public consultation.

नरेंद्र मोदी जनता से वसूली का नया प्लान लाए हैं। अब ₹2,000 से ऊपर के UPI पेमेंट पर सरकार वसूली करेगी। प्लान है कि ₹2,000 से ऊपर के हर UPI पेमेंट पर 0.5% चार्ज वसूला जाए, मतलब - • अगर आपने ₹5,000 की खरीदारी की तो ₹25 का चार्ज लगेगा • अगर ₹10,000 की खरीदारी की तो ₹50 वसूला जाएगा पहले UPI पेमेंट पूरी तरह फ्री था, लेकिन नरेंद्र मोदी से ये देखा नहीं गया और यहां भी वसूली का खेल शुरू कर दिया। मोदी का फंडा साफ है - जितना हो सके जनता को लूट लो और अपने मित्र की तिजोरी भरो। ये सरकार जनता की सरकार नहीं है, ये चंद उद्योगपतियों की सरकार है और नरेंद्र मोदी उनके एजेंट।

पंजाब ने नशे के खिलाफ लड़ाई में रास्ता दिखाया है। अब BJP अपने राज्यों में नशे का धंधा बंद करे और नौजवान पीढ़ी को बख्श दे। राजनीति छोड़िए, पंजाब से सीखिए और अपने राज्यों को नशामुक्त कीजिए। Arvind Kejriwal (@ArvindKejriwal) 2022 में जब हमारी सरकार बनी थी तो 80% ड्रग्स पाकिस्तान से आती थी। “आप” सरकार ने एंटी ड्रोन सिस्टम लगाकर पाकिस्तान से आने वाली ड्रग्स पर काबू किया। आज केवल 20% ड्रग्स पाकिस्तान से आती हैं। आज 80% ड्रग्स बीजेपी शासित राज्यों से आ रही हैं - गुजरात, राजस्थान, हरियाणा, यूपी, दिल्ली। बीजेपी अपने राज्यों में नशे का धंधा रोकने में नाकाम रही है या रोकना नहीं चाहती? गुजरात में तीस साल से इनकी सरकार है और नशे का सबसे ज़्यादा धंधा वहाँ है। मुंद्रा पोर्ट से नशा भारत आता है जिसको रोकने की ज़िम्मेदारी केंद्र की बीजेपी सरकार की है। और इनकी बेशर्मी देखिए। पंजाब में ये लोग नशे के ख़िलाफ़ यात्रा निकाल रहे हैं। पंजाब से सीखो। “आप” से सीखो और अपने राज्यों में भी नशा ख़त्म करो। हर बात में राजनीति मत करो। — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/ArvindKejriwal/status/2099708901205631032#m

But at the end of the day, voluntary standards made by a handful of tech companies won’t be enough. We need government – and specifically our leaders in Washington – to get proactive in coming up with concrete proposals, laws and regulations that deal with serious safety concerns, anticipate AI’s impact on jobs and our kids, and make sure that AI’s benefits are widely spread. And we need the U.S. to take the lead in creating international standards for AI safety. Given what we know about technology, we can’t stuff AI back in a box. But we can collectively determine how it's developed and how it’s used, rather than sitting back and letting AI and its fallout happen to us.

So, we need to use this time to structure a more open, public and democratic conversation about AI. Building on the statements that the frontier companies have already made, some leaders in the space announced they’re launching what they call Project Blueprint to help tech companies and policy makers work together on setting stronger standards and guidelines for AI development. Andrew Ross Sorkin (@andrewrsorkin) Breaking in @dealbook: Jay Carney is joining SV Angel, Ron Conway’s venture capital firm, to run a new initiative called Project Blueprint. Its purpose is to rebuild bonds between leaders in the artificial intelligence sector and Democrats who are demanding new rules to regulate the technology. nytimes.com/2026/09/14/busin… — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/andrewrsorkin/status/2099478917228769570#m

I was encouraged this week to see the leaders of the frontier labs agree on the need for them to slow down the pace of AI development. Given the stakes, it’s a good and necessary first step. But I’m even more encouraged by the growing recognition that how this powerful new technology develops should be at the center of our public debate. I’ve been watching the progress on AI for over a decade now, and one thing that’s clear to me is that the potential impact of this technology is not overhyped. It’s also moving at lightning speed – and even faster than those who are engineering it can keep up with. I’m not an AI accelerationist who believes it will lead to some techno-utopia, and I’m not a doomer who thinks it will inevitably lead to humanity’s destruction. But whether this technology results in amazing breakthroughs in medicine, energy and education or unleashes huge economic disruptions, greater inequality, and potential catastrophe will depend on the choices that we make right now – choices that should be made not just by the companies involved, but by all of us.

Abiy told the summit that access to the sea is “first and foremost an economic imperative,” requiring reliable and diversified trade routes, and assured the international audience that #Ethiopia would pursue it through “peaceful and negotiated arrangements.” Notably absent was the phrase “sovereign sea access,” or "𝑜𝑤𝑛𝑒𝑟𝑠ℎ𝑖𝑝" a central term in Ethiopia’s domestic rhetoric. Military figures have even threatened, in Amharic broadcasts aimed at domestic audiences, to seize Eritrean territory and ports by force if Eritrea does not hand them over willingly, as though Assab port were a piece of candy to be given away. But switch the language to English and face the international audience, and voilà: no threats, no territorial claims, no talk of taking anything. Suddenly, it is all peaceful negotiations, economic necessity, and international trade. Apparently, Ethiopia has two foreign policies: one for the domestic audience, where Assab is treated like property waiting to be reclaimed, and another for the international audience, where the same ambition is dressed up as an innocent request for economic access. This is not merely diplomatic inconsistency. It is political theater with two scripts: one written for domestic mobilization, the other for international consumption. The real question is not whether Ethiopia knows there is a contradiction. It clearly does. The question is whether it genuinely believes the rest of the world cannot see it. Why do scientists put bands on birds? KD1 gives us a chance to explain. 🦅 If you’ve been following the Big Bear Lake, California bald eagle family, you may have noticed a new eagle at the nest. KD1 (Kaydee) has recently been seen in the nest with Shadow following the loss of Jackie. The band on KD1’s leg is more than an identification tag. It connects this eagle to the USGS’s Bird Banding Laboratory (BBL), which maintains more than 100 years of bird banding and encounter data. The BBL manages more than 7,700 federal bird banding and marking permits and distributes more than 1 million bird bands each year. These data help scientists study bird movements, survival and populations. Bald eagles are a powerful example of why this long-term science matters. Once severely threatened by contaminants such as DDT, their populations have made an extraordinary comeback. From one banded eagle to more than a century of data, every observation helps tell the story. Learn more about why we band birds: ow.ly/Mhfr50ZLyCw 📷: Image courtesy of Friends of Big Bear Valley

Near the Saky airfield in temporarily occupied Crimea, an occupier short-range radio navigation system was hit. In addition, three enemy repeaters were hit in Rokhmanove, Krasnyi Stiah and Kamin, Bryansk region, russian federation. The extent of the damage is being assessed. Statement by the CARICOM Eminent Persons Group on the visit to Haiti, 2-9 September 2026 The CARICOM Eminent Persons Group (EPG) visited Haiti from 2-9 September 2026 and held discussions with a large number, and broad range, of political and civil society stakeholders including the business community, youth, women and human rights organisations, key government institutions and the leadership of the Gang Suppression Force (GSF). The visit of the EPG also provided a timely opportunity to assess the political conjuncture and to engage in dialogue on the preparations for the first round of elections scheduled for 13 December 2026. The EPG observed several positive developments, including the work being undertaken to reignite an election process after more than ten years. The EPG noted that political parties were in various stages of preparation to participate in the forthcoming elections, including by forming political groupings. Stakeholders also expressed their views and concerns on the new measures required by the amended Electoral Decree. They claimed that many of these measures were unwieldy and onerous. They were particularly concerned by the number of documents candidates were required to provide to the Electoral Council (CEP) and the slow pace of the registration of electors. It was drawn to the attention of the EPG that the voter registration process was not meeting expectations. The process was constricted by the existence of territories beyond state control. Many of the stakeholders emphasized the need for greater public sensitisation on the process and wider availability of registration centres, Though striving to comply with the demands required to participate in the elections, a number of parties called for modification of some of the procedures and requirements that might necessitate a deferment of the December 13 election date. Stakeholders however expressed a yearning for fair, credible, impartial and inclusive elections to bring an end to the successive transitional arrangements that have been an unwelcome feature of the multidimensional crisis in Haiti. The security situation remains of particular concern. The EPG noted the recent spread and spike in deadly violence and kidnappings, as well as the challenges contributing to the slow deployment of the GSF. In their discussions, all stakeholders underscored the critical importance of ensuring a security environment that will allow for country-wide registration of voters, political campaigning, freedom of movement and for citizens to vote safely. Deployment of the additional forces and resources pledged by various countries and strategic operational coordination among these and the Haitian security forces are of paramount importance in achieving this objective. Haiti is at a critical juncture. With important steps being taken by Haitians towards stability and a return to democratic governance in their country, the EPG calls on international partners to refocus efforts to deliver with despatch on security commitments made to ensure the implementation of UN Security Council Resolution 2793. 14 September 2026

Every morning, before we even leave the house to school, my Grok Bot has already generated and printed fresh math worksheets for my kids. I don’t need to do nothing, it prints every day at 6am.. The papers are just sitting on my printer... ready to go. My 8 yr old is in 3rd grade. He gets 20 mixed problems that include multi-digit multiplication, exact division, addition, subtraction, and solve-for-X. My 5 yr old is in kindergarten. He gets 25 single-digit addition and subtraction problems. The worksheets are truly randomized with no repeats, black and white to save ink, plenty of room to work, a little quote at the top to start their day on the right note… and gets a bit more challenging depending on how they did the day before. Then it generates one combined answer key for me so I can check both of them fast at the end of the ride. Then, we just get in my Tesla, I turn on FSD, and instead of spending the whole drive focused on operating the car, I can focus on them and their development. I can sit with them. “What did you get for this one?” “Show me how you got there.” “Try that one again.” When one of them gets stuck, I’m there, like a private tutor, except I’m the Dad. In Silicon Valley, many families obsess over which math program, class, app, or curriculum is best and do a lot of crazy things tbh. And sure, I guess those things matter to a degree. But kids gotta be kids, and I don’t need to make learning complicated. I have Grok Bot. Every morning it gives each of my kids work that matches exactly where they’re at. Then tomorrow, it does it again. And again. And again. That consistency matters more to me than finding some “perfect” program. I care about habit and good habits add up. A week becomes hundreds of problems. A school year becomes thousands. And the whole thing happens during time we were already going to spend in the car anyway. That’s what I love about this setup that is enabled from the products of Elon’s companies. AI handles the repetitive stuff. Grok Bot creates the work, randomizes it, formats it, prints it at 6 AM, and makes my answer key. Tesla FSD handles the drive. And I get the part that actually matters… Sitting next to my kids. Watching how they think. Seeing where they struggle. Explaining something a different way when it doesn’t click. Giving them a little confidence when they get frustrated. And watching them get better over time. I’m really not trying to turn every morning into school… I hated school, I know how it is. I’m just using technology to create a small daily habit that would’ve taken a lot more effort before. This is where AI quietly is removing removes friction from my life every single day. And ultimately making me a better Dad and raising stronger children.

Remittances are one of the world’s most resilient sources of household finance, supporting more than 1.1 billion people. The 2026 #SendingMoneyHome report, released today by the IFAD-administered Financing Facility for Remittances (FFR), examines how these flows changed over the past decade and explores the impact of migrant workers’ remittances on families, communities and development in low- and middle-income countries. Key findings show that: 🔹Remittance flows nearly doubled: Asia still receives half, Latin America grew fastest and flows to Africa nearly doubled. 🔹Around 220 million migrant workers send money home worldwide and by 2030, migrants and diaspora are expected to send more than US$3.6 trillion cumulatively to their home countries. 🔹About 1/3 of these remittances go to rural areas, where they can also open pathways to savings, insurance and investment in enterprises and other livelihood opportunities. The report’s findings and recommendations provide a practical basis for action by both the public and private sectors. Download the 2026 Sending Money Home report at ifad.org/en/w/news/remittanc… #FinancingTheFirstMile | @FFRemittances Video

Remittance inflows to low- and middle-income countries reached US$728.6 billion in 2025 – more than four times global official development assistance that year and greater than foreign direct investment to those countries, according to the 2026 Sending Money Home report launched today by IFAD. According to the report, remittances have remained one of the world's largest and most consistent sources of household finance over the past decade, helping families meet basic needs, build resilience and invest in their futures, even in times of crisis. “As remittances help families meet their basic needs, they are also building financial growth and resilience to shocks,” said @IFADPresident Alvaro Lario. “Their potential benefits are greatest when families have access to affordable and trusted financial services, together with the knowledge, freedom and appropriate options to use their resources according to their own needs and aspirations,” added Lario. The findings highlight opportunities for policymakers to strengthen the impact of remittances on resilience, financial inclusion and economic opportunity while recognizing that these private flows cannot replace public investment, social protection or climate finance. ময়মনসিংহ মেডিকেল কলেজ হাসপাতালে (মমেক) আগুন লাগার ঘটনা ঘটেছে। এ সময় আতঙ্কে হুড়োহুড়ি করে নামতে গিয়ে পদদলিত হয়ে এক শিশুসহ ছয়জন মা'রা গেছেন। সোমবার (১৪ সেপ্টেম্বর) সন্ধ্যা ৬টার দিকে হাসপাতালের বহির্বিভাগে (নতুন ভবন) এ অগ্নিকাণ্ড ঘটে। নি'হ'ত'রা হলেন- হাজেরা বেগম (৫০), শাহজাহান (৪০), রমজান (৩৮), জাহানারা (৫০) ও কুলসুমা (৩৫)। এ ছাড়া অজ্ঞাত এক শিশুও মা'রা যায়। হাসপাতাল সূত্রে জানা গেছে, সন্ধ্যা ৬টার দিকে হাসপাতালের নতুন ভবনের একটি লিফটে আগুনের সূত্রপাত হয়। খবর পেয়ে ফায়ার সার্ভিসের ময়মনসিংহ সদর স্টেশনের তিনটি ইউনিট ও বাংলাদেশ কৃষি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় স্টেশনের একটি ইউনিটসহ মোট চারটি ইউনিট ঘটনাস্থলে পৌঁছে আগুন নিয়ন্ত্রণে কাজ শুরু করে। প্রায় এক ঘণ্টার চেষ্টায় আগুন নিয়ন্ত্রণে আসে। আগুনে কোনো হতাহত না থাকলেও আগুন লাগার খবরে রোগী ও তাদের স্বজনদের মধ্যে আতঙ্ক ছড়িয়ে পড়ায় হুড়োহুড়ি কের সিঁড়ি দিয়ে নামতে গিয়ে পদদলিত হয়ে অজ্ঞাতপরিচয় একটি শিশুসহ ছয়জন মা'রা যান। #Mymensingh #MedicalEmergency #HospitalFire #somoytv

Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, today met with Ambassador of Australia to ASEAN, H.E. Tiffany McDonald, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat. Both sides discussed progress of ASEAN-Australia cooperation, particularly in light of the 5th anniversary of the ASEAN-Australia Comprehensive Strategic Partnership and the deliverables of this year. Both sides also exchanged views on regional developments of shared interest.

Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, today met with Ms. Yevhenia Shynkarenko, Chargé d’Affaires of the Embassy of Ukraine in Jakarta, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat, during which both sides discussed ways to promote relations between ASEAN and Ukraine.

Ambassador of the State of Qatar to ASEAN, Dr. Sultan bin Mubarak Saad Al-Dosari, presented his Letter of Credence to Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat today. Secretary-General Dr. Kao congratulated Ambassador Al-Dosari on his appointment and looked forward to working closely with him to further advance ASEAN-Qatar relations, particularly following the conferment of ASEAN Sectoral Dialogue Partner (SDP) status on Qatar at the 59th ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Meeting on 21 July 2026, in Manila, the Philippines. He encouraged Qatar to work closely with ASEAN Member States and the ASEAN Secretariat to substantiate the newly established SDP. He further highlighted potential areas of cooperation between ASEAN and Qatar, including education and human resource development, public health, economic empowerment, climate change and environmental cooperation, disaster resilience, and capacity building. Ambassador Al-Dosari expressed Qatar’s commitment to enhancing its engagement with ASEAN and ASEAN Member States and to further strengthening cooperation under the newly established SDP. Both sides also looked forward to developing the ASEAN-Qatar Practical Cooperation Areas (2027-2031), which will serve as practical roadmap for implementing cooperation under ASEAN-Qatar SDP and further substantiate the partnership over the next five years. Qatar acceded to the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia in 2022 and has accredited its Ambassador to ASEAN since 2017. Ambassador Al-Dosari succeeds Ambassador Fawziya Bint Edrees Salman Al-Sulaiti, who completed her tenure on 17 May 2024. Ambassador Al-Dosari is the third Ambassador of Qatar to ASEAN.

The Iran war is changing again, and not in a good way: 1. Iran is expanding the war horizontally, with attacks on new sites and with new actors, away from the central U.S.-Iran battlefield. 2. The nightmare oil scenario is both a closed Strait of Hormuz and a blocked Nab el-Mandeb. That’s what Iran is now trying for, adding overland infrastructure to the mix as well. 3. The Houthis have recently seized a port and an island in the Red Sea. Iranian proxies based in Iraq attacked Saudi energy infrastructure with drones. The Saudis turned off their East-West pipeline. 4. Mohammed bin Salman reportedly asked the U.S. to join the fight against the Houthis. Trump apparently said no. Interestingly but not surprisingly, Turkey and Pakistan aren’t fighting for Saudi either, despite their brand-new trilateral defense agreement. 5. Trump is no doubt wary of restarting a fight like the one last year, in which the U.S. spent weeks, and lots of resources, bombing Houthi positions to free up Red Sea. It didn’t work. The U.S. cut a deal with the Houthis rather than defeat them militarily. 6. Despite that, it’s hard to see the U.S. sitting idle if the Houthis continue to advance. You could well see American involvement in Yemen and in the Strait simultaneously. 7. Step back and you can see a new Iranian strategy. As the Strait becomes less important - more ships moving through, more alternative pathways established - Tehran threatens the alternatives. In the meantime, it continues firing on ships transiting the Strait. 8. The U.S. says traffic through the Strait is returning toward prewar levels. I’ve heard from allied governments who believe the numbers are overstated. And global oil prices don’t suggest a restoration. 9. Tomorrow Iranian officials are meeting with Gulf leaders. Previously the Gulf worried that the U.S. would reach a peace agreement with Tehran that left them dangerously exposed. With U.S.-Iran talks stalled, Washington has to worry about its Gulf allies cutting deals with Tehran to protect themselves. 10. That could mean recognizing some degree of Iranian authority over the Strait, which is precisely what the U.S. has tried to avoid. 11. Trump predicts the war will end right after the midterm elections. I doubt it. With the horizontal escalation we are seeing now, it’s likelier that this has at least months more to go.

It seems most people don't understand how severe the energy situation is right now in the Middle East. As of Friday, Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline has officially been shut down after recent attacks, putting -4 million barrels of daily oil exports at risk. Meanwhile, the Bab el-Mandeb Strait is now at risk of being shut down, threatening up to -9 million barrels of daily oil supply. All while the Strait of Hormuz is operating at ~20% of its pre-Iran War capacity, removing -15 million barrels of daily oil flows. Combined, this represents nearly ~30 MILLION barrels per day of oil flows that are either offline or at risk. Even after accounting for some overlap between these routes, the scale of the potential disruption is enormous relative to the ~100 million barrel per day global oil market. This is one of the most severe energy supply situations in modern history.

'हनुमान अंश' की सक्सेस के बाद डायरेक्टर ने अनाउंस की नई फिल्म, 'रामबोला' में दिखेगी तुलसीदास की जिंदगी 2 करोड़ के छोटे बजट में बनी फिल्म हनुमान अंश ने 200 करोड़ की कमाई की है. फिल्म को दर्शकों का काफी प्यार मिला है. फिल्म की सफलता के बाद डायरेक्टर विशाल चतुर्वेदी ने अपनी अगली फिल्म का ऐलान कर दिया है. हनुमान अंश बनाने के बाद अब विशाल नई कहानी के साथ पर्दे पर आएंगे. हनुमान अंश को डायरेक्टर करने वाले विशाल चतुर्वेदी ने ही फिल्म की कहानी लिखी है. वहीं अब फिल्म मेकर ने नई फिल्म का ऐलान कर दिया है. डायरेक्टर जल्द ही रामबोला फिल्म बनाएंगे. महावीर जैन फिल्म्स के साथ मिलकर वह गोस्वामी तुलसीदास के जीवन को पर्दे पर दिखाएंगे. फिल्म रामबोला की कहानी और डायरेक्शन खुद विशाल चतुर्वेदी करेंगे. फिल्म की कहानी गोस्वामी तुलसीदास के जीवन पर आधारित होगी. फिल्म में भक्ति, साहित्य और भारतीय संस्कृति को दिखाया जाएगा. फिल्म का निर्माण महावीर जैन, विशाल चतुर्वेदी, अमित उपाध्याय कर रहे हैं. हनुमान अंश के बाद विशाल चतुर्वेदी की फिल्म रामबोला पर्दे पर कमाल दिखा पाएगी या नहीं इसका तो खुलासा आने वाले ही समय में होगा. फिल्म रामबोला में गोस्वामी तुलसीदास जी के रोल में कौन होगा, इसके बारे में खास जानकारी नहीं है. ना ही फिल्म की स्टार कास्ट को लेकर कोई जानकारी सामने आई है. . . विशाल चतुर्वेदी की फिल्म हनुमान अंश ने इतिहास रच दिया है. 2 करोड़ में बनी फिल्म ने 200 करोड़ की कमाई की है. हनुमान अंश ने कई बड़ी फिल्म को थिएटर में हरा दिया. बॉक्स ऑफिस पर फिल्म ताबड़तोड़ कमाई कर रही है. फिल्म ने 38 दिनों में इंडिया में 214 करोड़ का बिजनेस किया है. वर्ल्डवाइड फिल्म ने 268 करोड़ से ज्यादा का बिजनेस किया है. 2 करोड़ में बनी फिल्म हनुमान अंश के सामने यश की टॉक्सिक फिल्म ज्यादा दिन नहीं चल पाई. हनुमान अंश बिना किसी प्रमोशन के बॉक्स ऑफिस पर हिट हुई है. गोस्वामी तुलसीदास भारतीय साहित्य के संत और कवि माने जाते है. उन्होंने रामायण को अवधी अनुवाद रामचरितमानस के लिए जाने जाते हैं. उनकी रचना में भगवान राम के लिए उनकी भक्ति और समर्पण दिखता है. #HanumanAnsh #Tulsidas #RamBola #VishalChaturvedi

In Sochi, Krasnodar Krai, russian federation, a 92N6 multifunctional radar station belonging to the S-400 Triumf surface-to-air missile system was hit. ℹ️ Background. The 92N6 is a multifunctional radar station that tracks airborne targets and guides surface-to-air missiles towards them. Within the S-400 system, it is one of the key elements responsible for carrying out the system’s air defence engagement tasks. In the areas of Kursk, Kursk region, russian federation, and Donetsk, sites used for the storage, preparation and launch of attack UAVs were hit. In Novohrodivka, Donetsk region, an enemy UAV unit command post was also hit. Enemy radar stations were hit in the areas of Lityzh, Trostenchyk and Lypovets, Bryansk region, russian federation. Near the Saky airfield in temporarily occupied Crimea, an occupier short-range radio navigation system was hit. In addition, three enemy repeaters were hit in Rokhmanove, Krasnyi Stiah and Kamin, Bryansk region, russian federation. The extent of the damage is being assessed. Operations against key military targets of the russian aggressor are ongoing. To be continued! 💥 Glory to Ukraine! 🇺🇦

Planted Avicennia marina, a species of Mangrove, in the Jakhau Mangrove Nursery in Kutch, Gujarat. Under the MISHTI (Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats & Tangible Incomes) programme initiated by PM Shri @narendramodi ji, Kutch is undertaking large-scale mangrove restoration, scientific nursery development and livelihood initiatives. Against a cumulative plantation target of 29,250 hectares for 2023–24 to 2026–27, mangrove plantation has been completed over 27,652 hectares, including 12,450 hectares in the Kori Creek area. Approximately 3.49 lakh mangrove seedlings have been raised at the Jakhau Mangrove Nursery. Interacted with subject experts to understand the challenges and technological and nature-based solutions to address the same. Kutch is developing a comprehensive model of mangrove conservation by combining large-scale plantation, nurseries, biodiversity conservation, innovative tidal technology, renewable energy, community participation and sustainable livelihoods. Jakhau Mangrove Nursery is a significant example of technology-driven and community-oriented mangrove restoration in Gujarat.

कांग्रेस पार्टी और राहुल गांधी आजकल बहुत बड़े-बड़े भाषण दे रहे हैं और उधर उनकी सरकारों में अलग-अलग तरीके के भ्रष्टाचार के नए स्वरूप सामने आ रहे हैं। कर्नाटक के PWD मिनिस्टर सतीश जारकीहोली जी के यहां पड़े छापों में सिर्फ इतनी ही बात सामने नहीं आई है कि कितनी संपत्ति है, यह भी बात सामने आई है कि उन लोगों ने विदेश में कई जगह सोने की खदानें ली थीं। इस प्रकार के तथ्य प्रकाश में आए हैं, इस प्रकार की जानकारी मीडिया में आई है कि कांगो और जाम्बिया जैसी जगहों पर भी माइनिंग के इन्वेस्टमेंट के सबूत मिले हैं। अर्थात् कांग्रेस पार्टी के शासनकाल में भ्रष्टाचार वैश्विक रूप धारण कर चुका है। इनके नेता प्रतिपक्ष देश-विदेश घूमते हैं और इनके नेता देश-विदेश में जाकर इन्वेस्टमेंट करते हैं। गंभीर बात ये है कि कांग्रेस पार्टी भारतीय समाज को तोड़ने के लिए intellectual investment बाहर से अपने दिमाग में लाती है और भ्रष्टाचार करके financial investment अपनी सरकारों से ले जाकर विदेश में करती है। कांग्रेस का यह बहुत खतरनाक चरित्र सामने है कि भारतीय समाज को बांटो, तोड़ो, टकराहट पैदा करो और इसके लिए फॉर्मूले, थ्योरियां और भ्रामक सामग्री विदेश से प्राप्त करो और फिर यहां से भ्रष्टाचार करके देश की जनता की गाढ़ी कमाई का पैसा अपनी जेबों में भरकर विदेश की खदानों में लेकर जाकर स्थापित करो। कर्नाटक की जनता बहुत गंभीरता से इस विषय को देख रही है और इसका करारा जवाब देगी। - डॉ. @SudhanshuTrived Video

In their recent op-ed, published in @IndianExpress and @FinancialXpress (India), @agulati115 and Sulakshana Rao argue that if India is to create productive jobs at scale, the textiles and apparel sector must lead the way, with Tiruppur offering the blueprint. With agriculture still accounting for 43% of India's workforce against just 12.1% for manufacturing, the authors make the case for T&A as a labour-intensive, women-employing sector that can train workers in about 60 days. Tiruppur shows the model with its knitwear exports rising from $3.3 billion to $5.3 billion in four years, handling 68% of India's knitwear exports and supporting over a million livelihoods within one 20-km ecosystem. But scaling it needs many more such clusters, and the seven PM MITRA parks need to be operationalised on a war-footing basis. Real test of #ViksitBharat is whether it can create enough productive jobs. T&A offers a clear opportunity. But it needs the PM’s focus to expedite its execution. Depuis le premier jour, j’ai pris un engagement : protéger nos enfants en ligne. Nous irons au bout. À la suite de la décision rendue par le Conseil constitutionnel à la mi-août sur l’interdiction des réseaux sociaux aux moins de 15 ans, j’avais chargé le Premier ministre de trouver une voie de passage conforme aux observations du Conseil et au droit européen. C’est chose faite. Après un travail technique rigoureux, le Gouvernement notifie aujourd’hui de nouvelles écritures à la Commission, un mois après la décision du Conseil. Cette protection doit aussi devenir la norme pour tous les enfants européens. C’est pourquoi j’ai partagé avec la Présidente de la Commission européenne ma détermination à ce que l’Europe avance de façon rapide et exigeante, pour harmoniser cette interdiction au niveau de l’Union et encadrer les fonctionnalités des plateformes. Grâce à la détermination de la Présidente de la Commission, des parlementaires et au soutien de nombreux États européens qui partagent avec nous cette exigence, je me réjouis que la protection des mineurs en ligne soit désormais une priorité de notre Europe, au cœur des orientations de cette rentrée. La France apportera tout son soutien, avec exigence et détermination. Ne rien lâcher.

The Caribbean’s progress and challenges in protecting biodiversity were put before a global audience in Kunming, China, this month, as the Caribbean Community (CARICOM) Secretariat joined stakeholders from around the world to take stock of how the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework is being implemented. Ms Teshia JnBaptiste, Senior Project Officer in the Secretariat’s Sustainable Development Programme, represented the CARICOM Secretariat at the Kunming Dialogue on Collective Progress, held from 7 to 9 September, following regional consultations on 6 September. JnBaptiste brought a regional perspective to the discussions and raised matters of relevance to the Caribbean. She also highlighted the Secretariat’s progress, challenges and next steps at a networking session for sub-regional Technical and Scientific Cooperation centres under the Convention on Biological Diversity. The Dialogue provided an opportunity for Parties and representatives of Indigenous Peoples and local communities, women and youth, academia, the private and financial sectors, experts and other stakeholders to exchange views and contribute to the global review of progress in implementing the Framework. The Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework, which aims to halt and reverse biodiversity loss by 2030, was adopted in December 2022. It features 23 targets to be met by 2030 and four global goals to preserve biodiversity for current and future generations.

Law enforcers already have authority to charge companies and their CEOs for creating and releasing dangerous, unvetted, or defective products. We shouldn’t let discussions about new legal regimes distract from the fact that there’s no AI exemption from laws already on the books — a point @FTC emphasized repeatedly during my tenure. 1. There is an extensive set of laws that govern dangerous and defective products. For example, releasing unvetted AI models or agents can violate consumer protection laws. Shipping flawed AI tools without implementing adequate measures to detect and stop rogue or defective AI agents can be an “unfair or deceptive” act or practice under the FTC Act (and analogous state laws). And some state AGs are already exploring holding AI firms and their CEOs criminally liable when their models participate in criminal activity. 2. Existing laws also prohibit “unfair methods of competition.” This covers instances where AI firms appropriate the competitively sensitive information of their customers, including through tracking their use of various tools. It can also cover instances where firms pursue dangerous behavior, aware that doing so may compel rivals to do the same. As the Supreme Court has noted: “A method of competition which casts upon one's competitors the burden of the loss of business unless they will descend to a practice which they are under a powerful moral compulsion not to adopt, even though it is not criminal, was thought to involve the kind of unfairness at which the [unfair methods of competition] statute was aimed." 3. The highly concentrated and interconnected structure of these markets could be creating major risks and conflicts of interest. We had started investigating these partnerships and cross-investments across the stack (and released a preliminarily overview of some findings: ftc.gov/news-events/news/pre…). Both federal and state enforcers should be scrutinizing these opaque relationships and inter-dependencies. We are already seeing how these relationships could undermine accountability. For example, OpenAI could face liability given the Hugging Face incident, but Hugging Face being bought up by Nvidia means that we’re unlikely to see it file a lawsuit over this — given Nvidia’s strong incentive to see OpenAI continue full speed ahead. 4. As AI tools dramatically change the landscape of cybersecurity risks and hacks, all businesses should be doubling down on having core security protections in place. Firms that fail to invest in adequate data security measures or fix known vulnerabilities can also be breaking the law. A recent analysis showed that around 1/3 of Fortune 100 companies do not even have a way to notify them about security issues. During my @FTC tenure, we sued firms for poor data security practices and held CEOs liable when they were personally responsible. this.weekinsecurity.com/doze… ftc.gov/news-events/news/pre… 5. As policymakers consider new legal regimes, we should be looking to lessons from prior efforts to govern major sectors, such as banking and other networks, platforms, and utilities. Tools like structural separations, nondiscrimination, and supervision could be key, and there’s a rich history of what works and what doesn’t. But we can and must pursue any new efforts alongside enforcing existing laws.

ফি/লি/স্তি/নে/র গা/জা/য় যু/দ্ধবিরতির আলোচনার ক্ষেত্রে মার্কিন প্রেসিডেন্ট ডনাল্ড ট্রাম্প তার বিশেষ দূত স্টিভ উইটকফ ও জামাতা জ্যারেড কুশনারের ভূয়সী প্রশংসা করেছেন। একইসঙ্গে গা/জা/য় এখন তেমন কোনো সংঘাত নেই বলেও দাবি করেছেন তিনি। বিস্তারিত: ফি/লি/স্তি/নের গা/জা/য় যু/দ্ধবিরতির আলোচনার ক্ষেত্রে মার্কিন প্রেসিডেন্ট ডনাল্ড ট্রাম্প তার বিশেষ দূত স্টিভ উইটকফ ও জামাতা জ্যারেড কুশনারের ভূয়সী প্রশংসা করেছেন। একইসঙ্গে গাজায় এখন তেমন কোনো সংঘাত নেই বলেও দাবি করেছেন তিনি। সিআইএ প্রধান জন র‌্যাটক্লিফ বিশেষ দূত উইটকফ ও কুশনারের স্থলাভিষিক্ত হওয়ার গুঞ্জনের মধ্যেই ট্রাম্প এ মন্তব্য করলেন। রোববার (১৩ সেপ্টেম্বর) এয়ার ফোর্স ওয়ান-এ সাংবাদিকদের প্রশ্নের জবাবে ট্রাম্প বলেন, ‘না, তারা চমৎকার কাজ করছে। উদাহরণস্বরূপ গাজার দিকে তাকান। খেয়াল করুন যে আমরা সব জিম্মিকে ফিরিয়ে আনতে পেরেছি।’ তিনি আরও বলেন, ‘গা/জা/য় এখন আর তেমন লড়াই হচ্ছে না। হামাসও অস্ত্র ত্যাগ করতে রাজি।’ ২০২৫ সালের অক্টোবরে গা/জা/য় যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের মধ্যস্থতায় হা/মা/স ও ই/স/রা/ই/লে/র মধ্যে যুদ্ধবিরতি কার্যকর হয়। তবে এরপরও গাজায় ইসরাইলের হামলা থামেনি। যুদ্ধবিরতি কার্যকরের পর নেতানিয়াহু বাহিনীর হামলায় উপত্যকাটিতে ১ হাজার ৩৬৯ জন নিহত ও ৪ হাজার ৬২৭ ফি/লি/স্তি/নি আহত হয়েছেন। এই সময়ের মধ্যেই ২০২৬ সালের জানুয়ারিতে ডনাল্ড ট্রাম্পের ‘বোর্ড অব পিস’-এর কার্যক্রম শুরু হয়েছিল। #news #update #somoytv

ইরানে মার্কিন এফ-১৫ই যুদ্ধবিমান ভূপাতিত হওয়ার পর দেশটির সামরিক বাহিনীকে ফাঁকি দিতে প্রায় ৭ হাজার ফুট উঁচু একটি পাহাড়ের চূড়ায় উঠে পড়েছিলেন গুরুতর আহত মার্কিন বিমানবাহিনীর কর্নেল। সিবিএস নিউজের ‘৬০ মিনিটস’-কে দেয়া সাক্ষাৎকারে নিজের সেই ভয়াবহ অভিজ্ঞতার কথা জানিয়েছেন তিনি। বিস্তারিত : নিরাপত্তার কারণে ওই কর্নেলের পরিচয় প্রকাশ করা হয়নি। সাক্ষাৎকারে তাকে ‘ব্রাভো’ নামে ডাকা হয়। এপ্রিল মাসে ইরানে অভিযান চলাকালে এফ-১৫ই স্ট্রাইক ঈগল যুদ্ধবিমানটি ভূপাতিত হওয়ার পর তিনি ইরানের মাটিতে আটকা পড়েছিলেন। প্রায় দুই দিন শত্রুপক্ষের নিয়ন্ত্রিত এলাকায় অবস্থান করার পর মার্কিন বিশেষ বাহিনীর হাতে উদ্ধার হন তিনি। মার্কিন কর্মকর্তারা এটিকে সাম্প্রতিক ইতিহাসের সবচেয়ে জটিল সামরিক অনুসন্ধান ও উদ্ধার অভিযানের অন্যতম বলে বর্ণনা করেছেন। ব্রাভো ছিলেন দুই আসনের এফ-১৫ই স্ট্রাইক ঈগল যুদ্ধবিমান ‘ডুড ৪৪’-এর অস্ত্র ব্যবস্থাপনা কর্মকর্তা। বিমান থেকে বের হয়ে পড়ার পর ব্রাভো ও পাইলট ‘আলফা’ প্রায় ৫ মাইল দূরে বিচ্ছিন্ন হয়ে যান। আলফাকে কয়েক ঘণ্টার মধ্যেই উদ্ধার করা হলেও একাধিক আঘাত পাওয়া ব্রাভো নিখোঁজ ছিলেন পাহাড়ি এলাকায়। সিবিএসের সাংবাদিক নোরা ও’ডনেলকে ব্রাভো বলেন, ‘ওই মুহূর্তটি বর্ণনা করার সবচেয়ে ভালো উপায় হলো—মনে হচ্ছিল যেন একটি মালবাহী ট্রেন আমাকে ধাক্কা দিয়েছে।’ তিনি বলেন, “বিমানটি বাঁচানোর জন্য আমরা সর্বোচ্চ চেষ্টা করেছিলাম। কিন্তু দ্রুতই স্পষ্ট হয়ে যায়, সেটি আর সম্ভব নয়। এরপর আমরা বিমান থেকে বের হয়ে পড়ি এবং নিজেদের ইরানের ভূখণ্ডের ওপর ভাসমান অবস্থায় আবিষ্কার করি।’ ব্রাভোর ভাষ্য অনুযায়ী, বিমান থেকে বের হওয়ার পরই তিনি বুঝতে পারেন তাঁর প্যারাসুটে সমস্যা হয়েছে। একপর্যায়ে ওপরে তাকিয়ে তিনি প্যারাসুট দেখতে পাননি। সেই মুহূর্তটিকেই তিনি জীবনের সবচেয়ে ভয়ংকর দৃশ্য হিসেবে বর্ণনা করেছেন। তিনি জানান, কত দ্রুত নিচে পড়ছেন, সেদিকে মনোযোগ না দিয়ে প্যারাসুট মেলানো এবং সেটি ঠিক করার সর্বোচ্চ চেষ্টা করছিলেন। পরে সামরিক বিশেষজ্ঞরা হিসাব করে জানান, ঘণ্টায় প্রায় ৭০ থেকে ১০০ মাইল বেগে মাটিতে আঘাত করেছিলেন ব্রাভো। কীভাবে এমন পতনের পরও তিনি বেঁচে গেলেন—এমন প্রশ্নের জবাবে তিনি বলেন, ‘এটি আধুনিক যুগের এক অলৌকিক ঘটনা।’ মাটিতে বিধ্বস্তের পর ব্রাভোর পিঠ ভেঙে যায়। একই সঙ্গে তার এক হাত ও এক কাঁধ ভেঙে যায় এবং গোড়ালিতে মচকানোসহ মাথা ও মুখে কেটে-ছড়ে যাওয়ার আঘাত লাগে। তবে এত গুরুতর আহত হওয়ার পরও তিনি অবতরণের স্থান থেকে দ্রুত সরে যান। ব্রাভো বলেন, ‘আমার আঘাত লেগেছিল। কিন্তু আমরা যে পরিস্থিতির মুখোমুখি হই, সেগুলোর সঙ্গে মানিয়ে নিয়ে তা কাটিয়ে ওঠার প্রশিক্ষণই পাই। তাই আহত অবস্থাতেও যত দ্রুত সম্ভব অবতরণের স্থান থেকে সরে যাই।’ পরে তাকে উদ্ধারে বড় ধরনের অভিযান শুরু করে যুক্তরাষ্ট্র। শত শত মার্কিন সামরিক ও গোয়েন্দা সদস্য এতে অংশ নেন। এর মধ্যে সেনাবাহিনীর ডেল্টা ফোর্স ও নেভি সিল টিম সিক্সের মতো বিশেষ বাহিনীর সদস্যরাও ছিলেন। ব্রাভোকে খুঁজে বের করতে মার্কিন যুদ্ধবিমান ওই এলাকায় হামলা চালিয়ে পথ পরিষ্কার করে। বিমানটির পাইলটকে দুর্ঘটনার পরপরই উদ্ধার করা গেলেও ব্রাভোকে উদ্ধার করতে সময় লাগে ৫০ ঘণ্টা। পরে মার্কিন বিমানবাহিনীর বিশেষ উদ্ধারকারী দল পাহাড়ে পৌঁছে তাকে উদ্ধার করে। উদ্ধার অভিযানের আগে ইরানকে বিভ্রান্ত করতে সিআইএ একটি গোপন কৌশলও নিয়েছিল বলে জানানো হয়েছে। উদ্ধারের মুহূর্তের কথা বলতে গিয়ে ব্রাভো বলেন, পাহাড়ের চূড়ায় উদ্ধারকারীদের দেখতে পাওয়া ছিল তার জীবনের অন্যতম সেরা মুহূর্ত। তাদের প্রতি কৃতজ্ঞতা জানিয়ে তিনি বলেন, ওই ঘটনার পুরো অভিজ্ঞতা তার জীবনের সঙ্গে সবসময় থেকে যাবে। তথ্যসূত্র: গালফ নিউজ #news #update #somoytv
